instruction: Calculate maximum drawdown, total return, daily return volatility, and annualized volatility from the provided synthetic portfolio value series. Report the peak date, trough date, formulas, data window, unit, assumptions, and non-advice boundary.
prohibited_actions: using private portfolio or customer account data
presenting the risk metrics as an investment recommendation
claiming the synthetic calculation is production-ready
known_failure_modes: using absolute points instead of percent drawdown
population volatility when sample volatility is requested
